text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross crosses the finish line of
her debut
without issue. After the race,
however...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Urgh... The heck? My legs're shakin'...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, junior-level races shouldn't take
this much
outta me... Why do I feel so...
woozy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask her to rest a little before we reflect
on
today's events and formulate plans
for the future.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-it's not that big of a deal. Just a li'l
tired, that's
all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess that could be the case...
choice_data_list: ちゃんと食べなかったのが響いたのでは？

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well... I didn't think this was worth
bringin' up,
but...
choice_data_list: 大事なレース前なのに、なぜ……？

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't have that much of an appetite.
Been that
way since I was a kid...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, squirts! You two're still starvin',
right? Here,
have my share.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Brother
text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: But... aren't you hungry too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm stuffed. The next door neighbor
got me
some beef udon earlier.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So eat up, will ya? If ya don't, ya won't
grow up
big 'n strong.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I always made sure the li'l squirts ate
first, so my
stomach ended up shrinkin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guess I just got used to it. Now I even
feel like I
focus better on a light
stomach.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not sure it's somethin' I can
change
overnight. Trust me, too much
food spells trouble
for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...From the sounds of it, she's probably
tried to
increase her food intake in the
past to no avail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if we don't work on these ingrained
eating
habits, there's no way we'll be
able to build her
up to be more athletic.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry 'bout it. I might not be a
foodie, but
my guts are straight outta
Naniwa!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And the next place I wanna take these
guts is a
G1! How 'bout we try the
Hopeful Stakes or
somethin'? I gotta
hurry up 'n show the folks back
home
how far I've come!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why da heck not?! I know I can pull it
off! Geez,
talk about a party pooper!
choice_data_list: 目指すのはいいけど、目標にするのは……

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now's the time to make a push.
Don't
overthink it. Just go with the flow!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna do all that slow 'n steady
crap! I'm
good to go!
choice_data_list: 将来のためにも、体作りを優先しないか？
将来のためにも、体作りを優先しない？

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how bulky the other
runners are,
I'll send 'em flyin' 'n make
my family proud! I'm
not the same racer I
was before my debut!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A test, huh? Count me in!
choice_data_list: じゃあ明日テストしてみる？

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buonooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aarrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross makes her grand sumo
wrestling
debut, but it's not long before
she's knocked out
of the ring by the
towering yokozuna, Hishi
Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's all it took to send me flying?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Tch, so the big leagues are full of jumbo
runners
like her? If that's the case, hoo
boy...
choice_data_list: じゃあ体作りに専念する？

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right. I get it. We can stick to the
low-level
races for now while I bulk up.
But how long's that
gonna take?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's a good question. Even if we start
bulking
up right away, we won't see
results overnight.
We'll need to set a
tentative end date...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's ages away! C'mon, let's just go
straight to
the G1!
choice_data_list: ――来年の春。クラシック三冠の手前まで

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buoooono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fiiine! Next spring it is. That gives me till
then to
chow down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to build up our racing

experience slowly but surely between
now and
next spring.
